title: Boost paddle and Sport Boost feature
summary: Feedback centers on how the G70 boost paddle or button activates the Sport Boost feature, with one clear expression of satisfaction and several informational or how-to mentions.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the boost feature is pleasing to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback consists of descriptive or instructional mentions about how the boost paddle or button engages Sport Boost, without clear approval or criticism.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined instructional or descriptive statements, so sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster is based on a very small stratified sample and should not be treated as representative.
